subject: Discovery recap + proposed rotating demo windows (US/EU/APAC)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@meditech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed rotating demo windows (US/EU/APAC)

Hi Liam & Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary goals: reduce inference latency for your search assistant, centralize model serving across dev/prod, and introduce cost predictability for nightly batch workloads.
- Constraints you mentioned: strict EU data residency on audit logs, peak inference during EU business hours, and a small on-call team in APAC for emergency rollouts.

Next concrete step: a technical deep dive (45–60m) with your infra lead and our serving/runtime engineer to map network flows and talk quantization/kv-cache tradeoffs. To make the session equitable across your US/EU/APAC teams, we drafted a rotating-window suggestion below so different timezones see a friendly slot each week.

Proposed rotating cadence (weekly rotation, 3 options to pick from):
- Option A (US-friendly week): Tuesdays 9:00 AM PDT / 5:00 PM BST / 1:00 AM AET (next day)
- Option B (EU-balanced week): Wednesdays 2:00 PM BST / 6:00 AM PDT / 11:00 PM AET
- Option C (APAC-friendly week): Thursdays 10:00 AM AET / 2:00 PM BST / 6:00 PM PDT

Attached: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (proposed mutual action plan) and a calendar file with the three sample rotating slots (proposed_slots.ics). If you prefer, here's a one-click poll: https://cal.com/redwood/meditech-rotating-slots — it pre-fills local times.

Ask: can you confirm who should join from Meditech (names + roles) and which of Option A/B/C you'd prefer to start with for the first two weeks? Also, any hard blackout windows for on-call or release windows?

If helpful, Marcus will lead the deep dive on the runtime side and Monica will cover security/compliance items (audit logs, retention).

Thanks — looking forward to aligning calendars.

—
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood-inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (outline), proposed_slots.ics (sample rotating slots)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@meditech.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@meditech.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 08:07:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed rotating demo windows (US/EU/APAC)

Thanks, Irene — good summary. Priya and I chatted briefly after and a couple of quick notes:

- Please add our infra lead: Javier Morales (javier.morales@meditech.com) — he'll need to attend the deep dive.
- Preferred starting cadence: Option B (EU-balanced) looks like the best compromise for the next two weeks.
- Blackouts: we have a weekly maintenance window Mon 01:00–03:00 UTC and a quarterly release blackout on the first Friday of each quarter.

I'll let Javier and Priya confirm specific participant availability — can you hold Option B next Wed while we check internal calendars?

Also, quick question on the MAP: will the draft include expected delivery checkpoints for log retention proof and SOC artifact handoff?

Best,
Liam
Head of Platform Integrations | Meditech Health
liam.oconnor@meditech.com | +44 20 7946 0789

Hi all — Javier here (infra). Thanks for the recap and options. Quick availability from my side:
- Next Wednesday (Option B) works for 2:00 PM BST / 6:00 AM PDT / 11:00 PM AET — I can make that.
- Please include a short network diagram request in the invite so I can bring firewall rules and peering details.

Regarding the MAP: yes — we need checkpoints for SOC artifact handoff and a delivery target for audit-log retention proof. If you could add milestones (week 0: discovery + access, week 2: initial proof-of-concept, week 6: audit evidence snapshot), that would help with our procurement timeline.

Appreciate the quick responses — confirmed: we’ll hold Option B next Wednesday and I’ll send a calendar invite with an agenda and a short network diagram request.

Action items for Redwood:
- Finalize MAP with milestones you requested (Irene / Monica) — attached as Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf and I’ll iterate after your feedback.

- Create the rotating-series calendar invite and include timezone-localized times (ICS attached).
